verses.original: וַיִּפֹּ֥ל יוֹסֵ֖ף עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י אָבִ֑יו וַיֵּ֥בְךְּ עָלָ֖יו וַיִּשַּׁק־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip·pōl yō·w·sêp̄ ‘al- pə·nê ’ā·ḇîw way·yê·ḇək ‘ā·lāw way·yiš·šaq- lōw
verses.literal: Then Joseph fell upon his father’s face wept over him and kissed him
verses.literalPt: José se lançou sobre o rosto de seu pai, chorou sobre ele e o beijou.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֨ו יוֹסֵ֤ף אֶת־ עֲבָדָיו֙ אֶת־ הָרֹ֣פְאִ֔ים לַחֲנֹ֖ט אֶת־ אָבִ֑יו וַיַּחַנְט֥וּ הָרֹפְאִ֖ים אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ’eṯ- hā·rō·p̄ə·’îm la·ḥă·nōṭ ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇîw way·ya·ḥan·ṭū hā·rō·p̄ə·’îm ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel So they embalmed him
verses.literalPt: Ordenou a seus servos, os médicos, que embalsamassem a seu pai; e os médicos embalsamaram a Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּמְלְאוּ־ לוֹ֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם כִּ֛י כֵּ֥ן יִמְלְא֖וּ יְמֵ֣י הַחֲנֻטִ֑ים וַיִּבְכּ֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ מִצְרַ֖יִם שִׁבְעִ֥ים יֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·lə·’ū- lōw ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm kî kên yim·lə·’ū yə·mê ha·ḥă·nu·ṭîm way·yiḇ·kū ’ō·ṯōw miṣ·ra·yim šiḇ·‘îm yō·wm
verses.literal: taking the forty days required to complete - . . . the embalming And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days
verses.literalPt: Cumpriram-se-lhe quarenta dias, pois assim se cumprem os dias da embalsamação; e os egípcios choraram-no setenta dias.

verses.original: וַיַּֽעַבְרוּ֙ יְמֵ֣י בְכִית֔וֹ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יוֹסֵ֔ף אֶל־ בֵּ֥ית פַּרְעֹ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אִם־ נָ֨א מָצָ֤אתִי חֵן֙ בְּעֵ֣ינֵיכֶ֔ם דַּבְּרוּ־ נָ֕א בְּאָזְנֵ֥י פַרְעֹ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aḇ·rū yə·mê ḇə·ḵî·ṯōw way·ḏab·bêr yō·w·sêp̄ ’el- bêṯ par·‘ōh lê·mōr ’im- nā mā·ṣā·ṯî ḥên bə·‘ê·nê·ḵem dab·bə·rū- nā bə·’ā·zə·nê p̄ar·‘ōh lê·mōr
verses.literal: When the days of mourning had passed Joseph said to Pharaoh’s . . . court If I have found favor in your eyes please tell . . . . . . Pharaoh that . . .
verses.literalPt: Acabados os dias de o chorarem, disse José à casa de Faraó: Se agora achei graça aos vossos olhos, rogo-vos que faleis aos ouvidos de Faraó:

verses.original: אָבִ֞י הִשְׁבִּיעַ֣נִי לֵאמֹ֗ר הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִי֮ מֵת֒ בְּקִבְרִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר כָּרִ֤יתִי לִי֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן שָׁ֖מָּה תִּקְבְּרֵ֑נִי וְעַתָּ֗ה אֶֽעֱלֶה־ נָּ֛א וְאֶקְבְּרָ֥ה אֶת־ אָבִ֖י וְאָשֽׁוּבָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇî hiš·bî·‘a·nî lê·mōr hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî mêṯ bə·qiḇ·rî ’ă·šer kā·rî·ṯî lî bə·’e·reṣ kə·na·‘an šām·māh tiq·bə·rê·nî wə·‘at·tāh ’e·‘ĕ·leh- nā wə·’eq·bə·rāh ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî wə·’ā·šū·ḇāh
verses.literal: my father made me swear an oath when he said . . . I am about to die You must bury me . . . in the tomb that I dug for myself in the land of Canaan Now let me go . . . and bury my father and then return
verses.literalPt: Meu pai me fez jurar, dizendo: Eis que eu morro; no meu sepulcro que fiz abrir para mim na terra de Canaã, ali me sepultarás. Agora, pois, deixa-me subir e sepultar meu pai; depois, voltarei.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֑ה עֲלֵ֛ה וּקְבֹ֥ר אֶת־ אָבִ֖יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁבִּיעֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer par·‘ōh ‘ă·lêh ū·qə·ḇōr ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ka·’ă·šer hiš·bî·‘e·ḵā
verses.literal: Pharaoh replied Go up and bury your father as he made you swear to do
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Faraó: Vai sepultar teu pai como ele te fez jurar.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַל יוֹסֵ֖ף לִקְבֹּ֣ר אֶת־ אָבִ֑יו וַיַּֽעֲל֨וּ אִתּ֜וֹ כָּל־ עַבְדֵ֤י פַרְעֹה֙ זִקְנֵ֣י בֵית֔וֹ וְכֹ֖ל זִקְנֵ֥י אֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al yō·w·sêp̄ liq·bōr ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇîw way·ya·‘ă·lū ’it·tōw kāl- ‘aḇ·ḏê p̄ar·‘ōh ziq·nê ḇê·ṯōw wə·ḵōl ziq·nê ’e·reṣ- miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Then Joseph went to bury his father and all the servants of Pharaoh accompanied him the elders of Pharaoh’s household and all the elders of the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: José subiu para sepultar a seu pai; e com ele subiram todos os servos de Faraó, os anciãos da sua casa, e todos os anciãos da terra do Egito,

verses.original: וְכֹל֙ בֵּ֣ית יוֹסֵ֔ף וְאֶחָ֖יו וּבֵ֣ית אָבִ֑יו רַ֗ק טַפָּם֙ וְצֹאנָ֣ם וּבְקָרָ֔ם עָזְב֖וּ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ גֹּֽשֶׁן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl bêṯ yō·w·sêp̄ wə·’e·ḥāw ū·ḇêṯ ’ā·ḇîw raq ṭap·pām wə·ṣō·nām ū·ḇə·qā·rām ‘ā·zə·ḇū bə·’e·reṣ gō·šen
verses.literal: along with all of Joseph’s household and his brothers and his father’s household Only their children and flocks and herds were left in Goshen
verses.literalPt: e toda a casa de José, e seus irmãos e a casa de seu pai; somente deixaram na terra de Gósen os seus pequeninos, os seus rebanhos e os seus gados.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַל עִמּ֔וֹ גַּם־ רֶ֖כֶב גַּם־ פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וַיְהִ֥י הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה כָּבֵ֥ד מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al ‘im·mōw gam- re·ḵeḇ gam- pā·rā·šîm way·hî ham·ma·ḥă·neh kā·ḇêḏ mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Chariots and horsemen alike went up with him and it was an exceedingly large procession
verses.literalPt: Subiram com ele tanto carros como cavaleiros; e houve um concurso mui grande.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ עַד־ גֹּ֣רֶן הָאָטָ֗ד אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וַיִּ֨סְפְּדוּ־ שָׁ֔ם מִסְפֵּ֛ד גָּד֥וֹל וְכָבֵ֖ד מְאֹ֑ד וַיַּ֧עַשׂ לְאָבִ֛יו אֵ֖בֶל שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ‘aḏ- gō·ren hā·’ā·ṭāḏ ’ă·šer bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên way·yis·pə·ḏū- šām mis·pêḏ gā·ḏō·wl wə·ḵā·ḇêḏ mə·’ōḏ way·ya·‘aś lə·’ā·ḇîw ’ê·ḇel šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: When they reached . . . the threshing floor of Atad which is across the Jordan they lamented . . . and wailed loudly . . . . . . and Joseph mourned . . . for his father seven days
verses.literalPt: Vieram à eira de Atade, que está além do Jordão, e ali prantearam com mui grande e forte pranto sete dias; e fez José uma lamentação por seu pai.

verses.original: וַיַּ֡רְא יוֹשֵׁב֩ הָאָ֨רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֜י אֶת־ הָאֵ֗בֶל בְּגֹ֙רֶן֙ הָֽאָטָ֔ד וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֵֽבֶל־ כָּבֵ֥ד זֶ֖ה לְמִצְרָ֑יִם עַל־ כֵּ֞ן קָרָ֤א שְׁמָהּ֙ אָבֵ֣ל מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar yō·wō·šêḇ hā·’ā·reṣ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî ’eṯ- hā·’ê·ḇel bə·ḡō·ren hā·’ā·ṭāḏ way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·ḇel- kā·ḇêḏ zeh lə·miṣ·rā·yim ‘al- kên qā·rā šə·māh ’ā·ḇêl miṣ·ra·yim ’ă·šer bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: When the Canaanites of the land saw the mourning . . . at the threshing floor of Atad they said This is a solemn ceremony of mourning by the Egyptians Thus . . . the place across the Jordan is called . . . Abel-mizraim
verses.literalPt: Tendo os moradores da terra, os cananeus, visto o pranto na eira de Atade, disseram: Grande pranto é este dos egípcios; pelo que o lugar foi chamado Abel-Mizraim, que está além do Jordão.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ בָנָ֖יו ל֑וֹ כֵּ֖ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū ḇā·nāw lōw kên ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wām
verses.literal: So Jacob’s sons did as he had charged them
verses.literalPt: Fizeram-lhe seus filhos como lhes havia ordenado:

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂא֨וּ אֹת֤וֹ בָנָיו֙ אַ֣רְצָה כְּנַ֔עַן וַיִּקְבְּר֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ בִּמְעָרַ֖ת שְׂדֵ֣ה הַמַּכְפֵּלָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָנָה֩ אַבְרָהָ֨ם אֶת־ הַשָּׂדֶ֜ה לַאֲחֻזַּת־ קֶ֗בֶר מֵאֵ֛ת עֶפְרֹ֥ן הַחִתִּ֖י עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י מַמְרֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·’ū ’ō·ṯōw ḇā·nāw ’ar·ṣāh kə·na·‘an way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·ṯōw bim·‘ā·raṯ śə·ḏêh ham·maḵ·pê·lāh ’ă·šer qā·nāh ’aḇ·rā·hām ’eṯ- haś·śā·ḏeh la·’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ- qe·ḇer mê·’êṯ ‘ep̄·rōn ha·ḥit·tî ‘al- pə·nê mam·rê
verses.literal: They carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave at Machpelah in the field near . . . Mamre which Abraham - had purchased from Ephron the Hittite as a burial . . . site
verses.literalPt: levaram-no para a terra de Canaã e o sepultaram na cova no campo de Macpela, em frente de Manre, a qual Abraão comprou com o campo para posse de lugar de sepultura a Efrom heteu.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨שָׁב יוֹסֵ֤ף מִצְרַ֙יְמָה֙ ה֣וּא וְאֶחָ֔יו וְכָל־ הָעֹלִ֥ים אִתּ֖וֹ לִקְבֹּ֣ר אֶת־ אָבִ֑יו אַחֲרֵ֖י קָבְר֥וֹ אֶת־ אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ yō·w·sêp̄ miṣ·ray·māh hū wə·’e·ḥāw wə·ḵāl hā·‘ō·lîm ’it·tōw liq·bōr ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇîw ’a·ḥă·rê qā·ḇə·rōw ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: After . . . Joseph had buried his father he returned to Egypt . . . with his brothers and all who had gone with him to bury his father
verses.literalPt: Depois de haverem feito isto, voltou José para o Egito, ele, seus irmãos e todos os que com ele subiram para sepultar seu pai.

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֤וּ אֲחֵֽי־ יוֹסֵף֙ כִּי־ מֵ֣ת אֲבִיהֶ֔ם וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ ל֥וּ יִשְׂטְמֵ֖נוּ יוֹסֵ֑ף וְהָשֵׁ֤ב יָשִׁיב֙ לָ֔נוּ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר גָּמַ֖לְנוּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’ū ’ă·ḥê- yō·w·sêp̄ kî- mêṯ ’ă·ḇî·hem way·yō·mə·rū lū yiś·ṭə·mê·nū yō·w·sêp̄ wə·hā·šêḇ yā·šîḇ lā·nū ’êṯ kāl- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer gā·mal·nū ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead they said What if Joseph bears a grudge Then he will surely repay . . . us for all the evil that we did to him
verses.literalPt: Vendo os irmãos de José que seu pai tinha morrido, disseram: Porventura, José nos aborrecerá e nos retribuirá todo o mal que lhe fizemos.

verses.original: וַיְצַוּ֕וּ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֖ף לֵאמֹ֑ר אָבִ֣יךָ צִוָּ֔ה לִפְנֵ֥י מוֹת֖וֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw·wū ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ lê·mōr ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ṣiw·wāh lip̄·nê mō·w·ṯōw lê·mōr
verses.literal: So they sent word to Joseph saying Before he died . . . your father commanded
verses.literalPt: Mandaram, então, esta mensagem a José: Teu pai ordenou antes da sua morte, dizendo:

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ תֹאמְר֣וּ לְיוֹסֵ֗ף אָ֣נָּ֡א שָׂ֣א נָ֠א פֶּ֣שַׁע אַחֶ֤יךָ וְחַטָּאתָם֙ כִּי־ רָעָ֣ה גְמָל֔וּךָ וְעַתָּה֙ שָׂ֣א נָ֔א לְפֶ֥שַׁע עַבְדֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵ֣י אָבִ֑יךָ וַיֵּ֥בְךְּ יוֹסֵ֖ף בְּדַבְּרָ֥ם אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ṯō·mə·rū lə·yō·w·sêp̄ ’ān·nā śā nā pe·ša‘ ’a·ḥe·ḵā wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām kî- rā·‘āh ḡə·mā·lū·ḵā wə·‘at·tāh śā nā lə·p̄e·ša‘ ‘aḇ·ḏê ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ā·ḇî·ḵā way·yê·ḇək yō·w·sêp̄ bə·ḏab·bə·rām ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: This is what you are to say to Joseph I beg you please forgive the transgression and sin of your brothers for they did you wrong So now, Joseph please forgive the transgression of the servants of the God of your father When their message came to him Joseph wept
verses.literalPt: Assim direis a José: Perdoa a transgressão de teus irmãos e o seu pecado, porque te fizeram mal. Agora, pois, rogamos-te que perdoes a transgressão dos servos do Deus de teu pai. José chorou enquanto lhe falavam.

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכוּ֙ גַּם־ אֶחָ֔יו וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ לְפָנָ֑יו וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ הִנֶּ֥נּֽוּ לְךָ֖ לַעֲבָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·lə·ḵū gam- ’e·ḥāw way·yip·pə·lū lə·p̄ā·nāw way·yō·mə·rū hin·nen·nū lə·ḵā la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm
verses.literal: His brothers also came to him bowed down before him and said . . . We are your slaves
verses.literalPt: Vieram também seus irmãos, prostraram-se diante dele e disseram: Nós somos teus servos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֛ם יוֹסֵ֖ף אַל־ תִּירָ֑אוּ כִּ֛י הֲתַ֥חַת אֱלֹהִ֖ים אָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem yō·w·sêp̄ ’al- tî·rā·’ū kî hă·ṯa·ḥaṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ā·nî
verses.literal: But Joseph replied . . . Do not be afraid . . . Am I in the place of God
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes José: Não temais; acaso, estou eu em lugar de Deus?

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֕ם חֲשַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָלַ֖י רָעָ֑ה אֱלֹהִים֙ חֲשָׁבָ֣הּ לְטֹבָ֔ה לְמַ֗עַן עֲשֹׂ֛ה כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה לְהַחֲיֹ֥ת עַם־ רָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tem ḥă·šaḇ·tem ‘ā·lay rā·‘āh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥă·šā·ḇāh lə·ṭō·ḇāh lə·ma·‘an ‘ă·śōh kay·yō·wm haz·zeh lə·ha·ḥă·yōṯ ‘am- rāḇ
verses.literal: As for you what you intended against me for evil God intended for good in order to accomplish a day like this to preserve the lives of many people
verses.literalPt: Vós, na verdade, intentastes o mal contra mim; porém Deus o intentou para o bem, para fazer, como é agora, que se conserve muita gente em vida.

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ אַל־ תִּירָ֔אוּ אָנֹכִ֛י אֲכַלְכֵּ֥ל אֶתְכֶ֖ם וְאֶֽת־ טַפְּכֶ֑ם וַיְנַחֵ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ם וַיְדַבֵּ֖ר עַל־ לִבָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’al- tî·rā·’ū ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ă·ḵal·kêl ’eṯ·ḵem wə·’eṯ- ṭap·pə·ḵem way·na·ḥêm ’ō·w·ṯām way·ḏab·bêr ‘al- lib·bām
verses.literal: Therefore do not be afraid I will provide for you and your little ones So Joseph reassured his brothers and spoke kindly to them . . .
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, não temais; eu vos sustentarei a vós e a vossos filhinhos. Assim, os consolou e lhes falou ao coração.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב יוֹסֵף֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם ה֖וּא וּבֵ֣ית אָבִ֑יו וַיְחִ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף מֵאָ֥ה וָעֶ֖שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šeḇ yō·w·sêp̄ bə·miṣ·ra·yim hū ū·ḇêṯ ’ā·ḇîw way·ḥî yō·w·sêp̄ mê·’āh wā·‘e·śer šā·nîm
verses.literal: Now Joseph and his father’s household remained in Egypt . . . and Joseph lived to the age of 110 . . .
verses.literalPt: José habitou no Egito, ele e a casa de seu pai; e viveu cento e dez anos.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤רְא יוֹסֵף֙ לְאֶפְרַ֔יִם בְּנֵ֖י שִׁלֵּשִׁ֑ים גַּ֗ם בְּנֵ֤י מָכִיר֙ בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה יֻלְּד֖וּ עַל־ בִּרְכֵּ֥י יוֹסֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar yō·w·sêp̄ lə·’ep̄·ra·yim bə·nê šil·lê·šîm gam bə·nê mā·ḵîr ben- mə·naš·šeh yul·lə·ḏū ‘al- bir·kê yō·w·sêp̄
verses.literal: He saw Ephraim’s sons to the third generation and indeed the sons of Machir son of Manasseh were brought up on Joseph’s knees
verses.literalPt: Viu José os filhos de Efraim até a terceira geração; também os filhos de Maquir, filho de Manassés, nasceram sobre os joelhos de José.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יוֹסֵף֙ אֶל־ אֶחָ֔יו אָנֹכִ֖י מֵ֑ת וֵֽאלֹהִ֞ים פָּקֹ֧ד יִפְקֹ֣ד אֶתְכֶ֗ם וְהֶעֱלָ֤ה אֶתְכֶם֙ מִן־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את אֶל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֛ע לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yō·w·sêp̄ ’el- ’e·ḥāw ’ā·nō·ḵî mêṯ wê·lō·hîm pā·qōḏ yip̄·qōḏ ’eṯ·ḵem wə·he·‘ĕ·lāh ’eṯ·ḵem min- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer niš·ba‘ lə·’aḇ·rā·hām lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: Then Joseph said to his brothers I am about to die but God will surely visit . . . you and bring you up from this land to the land He promised on oath to Abraham Isaac and Jacob
verses.literalPt: Disse José a seus irmãos: Eu morro; porém Deus, certamente, vos visitará e vos fará subir desta terra para a terra que jurou a Abraão, a Isaque e a Jacó.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁבַּ֣ע יוֹסֵ֔ף אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר פָּקֹ֨ד יִפְקֹ֤ד אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְהַעֲלִתֶ֥ם אֶת־ עַצְמֹתַ֖י מִזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·ba‘ yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr pā·qōḏ yip̄·qōḏ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ·ḵem wə·ha·‘ă·li·ṯem ’eṯ- ‘aṣ·mō·ṯay miz·zeh
verses.literal: And Joseph made the sons of Israel take an oath and said God will surely attend to . . . you and then you must carry my bones up from this place
verses.literalPt: José fez os filhos de Israel jurar, dizendo: Certamente, Deus vos visitará, e fareis transportar deste lugar os meus ossos.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מָת יוֹסֵ֔ף בֶּן־ מֵאָ֥ה וָעֶ֖שֶׂר שָׁנִ֑ים וַיַּחַנְט֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ וַיִּ֥ישֶׂם בָּאָר֖וֹן בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ yō·w·sêp̄ ben- mê·’āh wā·‘e·śer šā·nîm way·ya·ḥan·ṭū ’ō·ṯōw way·yî·śem bā·’ā·rō·wn bə·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: So Joseph died at the age of 110 . . . . . . And they embalmed his body and placed it in a coffin in Egypt
verses.literalPt: Assim, morreu José, tendo cento e dez anos de idade; embalsamaram-no e puseram-no num caixão no Egito.
